title: Brasilidade: Measuring Brazilian Identity for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.12906v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work presents a new benchmark that aims to address the limitations of current methods for evaluating LLMs in Brazilian Portuguese. We introduced Brasilidade, an assessment methodology comprised of standardized tasks distributed across four different domains, and we are making available the tasks from its first domain, which address nuances of the language, grammar, and variations of Brazilian Portuguese. The results show that model size, by itself, does not determine performance; several medium-sized models outperformed larger models in the protocols evaluated. Specific models for Portuguese, in general, did not perform above average, despite their targeted training. Different task levels revealed significant nuances: while some tasks proved easy for most models, others posed extreme challenges, and some yielded mixed results, with wide variations in performance. translated_title: Brasilidade：衡量巴西身份认同的大语言模型评测基准
translated_abstract: 这项工作提出了一个新的基准，旨在解决当前评估大语言模型巴西葡萄牙语能力的方法的局限性。我们介绍了Brasilidade，这是一种由分布在四个不同领域的标准化任务组成的评估方法，我们正在发布其第一个领域的任务，这些任务涉及巴西葡萄牙语的语言细微差别、语法和语言变体。结果表明，模型规模本身并不能决定性能；在所评估的测试协议中，几个中等规模的模型表现优于更大的模型。针对葡萄牙语的专用模型总体而言表现并未超出平均水平，尽管它们经过了针对性训练。不同的任务难度水平揭示了显著的细微差别：虽然有些任务对大多数模型来说很容易，但另一些任务则构成了极大的挑战，还有一些任务结果参差不齐，性能差异很大。这清楚地说明了需要能够应对巴西葡萄牙语独特挑战的基准。
tldr: 该论文提出了Brasilidade基准，通过涵盖语言、语法等四个领域的标准化任务评估大语言模型的巴西葡萄牙语能力，发现模型规模并不决定性能，且葡萄牙语专用模型的表现也未超过平均水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Brasilidade, a benchmark consisting of standardized tasks across four domains for evaluating LLMs' Brazilian Portuguese proficiency, showing that model size alone does not determine performance and Portuguese-specific models do not outperform others.
